quarterly_data.quarter: Axe Compute press release: Axe Compute Receives $317 Million in Customer Prepayments (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Axe Compute has received over $317 million in customer prepayments under the more than $3 billion in AI infrastructure contracts announced on July 27, 2026 (five-year commitments with extension options, in new U.S. and European markets); these deployments are expected to begin recognizing revenue in late Q4 2026, and the prepayments reduce the external funding needed for initial deployment. Axe retains ownership of the infrastructure under its Axe Compute Build model.
quarterly_data.figure: over $317 million in customer prepayments; more than $3 billion in contracts
